answer_1.quote: We introduce iNews, a novel large-scale dataset specifically designed to capture the inherent subjectivity of affective responses to real-world news content...
answer_1.outputs: affective responses (e.g., valence, arousal, dominance, discrete emotions, sharing likelihood)

answer_2.quote: For evaluation, we employ three complementary metrics that capture different aspects of prediction quality: Mean Absolute Error (MAE) to measure overall prediction accuracy, Exact Accuracy to identify precise matches with annotator ratings, and ±1 Accuracy (the percentage of predictions falling within one point of the ground truth)...

answer_4.quote: We recruit annotators through Prolific, using quota sampling to ensure a relatively balanced representation across gender, age, political leaning, and UK geographical regions...
answer_4.guideline: Annotators are provided with detailed guidelines (see Section A.4), adapted from , which are accessible throughout the annotation process. For each news post screenshot, annotators provide five types of responses: Dimensional Emotion Ratings, Discrete Emotion Classifications, Modality Influence, Personal Relevance, Sharing Likelihood.
